channel.title: Battery Alert Pro Blog
channel.description: Practical articles on battery alerts, laptop longevity, and protecting unsaved work.

item.title: Windows Only Warns You at 10% Battery. Here's How to Get Warned Earlier
item.description: Windows warns you at 20% and 10% battery, then can shut down at 5%. Here is what the defaults actually mean, how to change them, and how to get an alert you cannot miss.

item.title: ADHD and Lost Work: Why Your Laptop Dying Is an Executive Function Problem
item.description: A surprise shutdown costs everyone a file. For people with ADHD it costs something else too: the momentum. Here is why the standard advice fails, and what to change instead.

item.title: Best Battery Monitoring Software for Windows 11 (2026)
item.description: Windows power tools fall into two different categories — health telemetry and alert-and-action tools. Here is an honest look at what each one is actually good for.

item.title: Charging Your Laptop to 100% Is Damaging Your Battery. Do This Instead
item.description: Modern lithium-ion cells are not ruined by a full charge. The real culprits are heat and time spent sitting at 100%. Here is what actually shortens battery life.
